cover.alt: Magazine cover of Vogue Italia, April 2021, issue number 847. Model Natalia Vodianova with blue-grey eyes and voluminous brown hair styled in vintage waves looks directly at the camera. She wears a honeycomb-patterned dress covered in multicolored sequins in green, red, black, and white, and a layered gold and diamond necklace with a snake-shaped pendant. The background is a soft pink gradient. Handwritten black text on the right side reads: "many friends have helped us in writing this book," decorated with two small gold bead ornaments.
